newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ pre-school subsidy up 5 pct, $37 mln over 3 yrs.
newsitem.headline: NZ pre-school subsidy up 5 pct, $37 mln over 3 yrs.

text.p: The New Zealand government would increase early childhood education subsidies by five percent from July, education ministers said on Monday.
The increase would cost NZ$37 million over three years, Education Minister Wyatt Creech and his associate Brian Donnelly said in a joint statement.

"This is significantly above the rate of headline inflation (currently 1.8 percent) and the $10 million promised in the coalition agreement," the ministers said in a statement billed as an early Budget announcement.

The Budget will be released at 2 p.m. (0200 GMT) on June 26. They said the increase demonstrated the government's commitment to early childhood education, but was only one part of the Budget package on early childhood education.
In the year to June the government spent $251.9 million on bulk subsidy grants to the sector.
The rise was on top of increased funding as a result of growth in roll numbers.
